name: 20331-prefillheavy-8bw8a8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, 131072 max positions. compressed-tensors int8 w8a8, bf16 unquantized dtype, ~8 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop) at streams=256, run TWICE back to back in one process (`streams: [256, 256]`) so every run carries its own replicate; warmup 10% and cooldown 10% both counted in REQUESTS, each benchmark bounded at 6000 requests with its own 900 s safety cap, seed static 20331. The scored numbers are the FIRST of the two.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: EXACTLY 1000 prompt tokens and 100 output tokens per request, min == max on both. Sent raw (`backend.request_format: plain`), so no chat template is applied and the prompt the engine sees is the declared 1000 tokens.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing page-length inputs into short briefs for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM launch arguments for this item.

model: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-quantized.w8a8

max-model-len: 32768
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own unquantized dtype (`torch_dtype` in its config.json).
dtype: bfloat16

# Written out rather than inherited: at this commit the defaults depend on which context the
# engine is built under (16384/1024, 8192/1024, or 2048 in process).
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Prompts are drawn independently and share no prefix, so this stays off and every request pays
# its own full 1000-token prefill.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# On by default at this engine; stated for the record.
enable-chunked-prefill: true
